regions.text: する一者はかしこにここに計らずち他者と避遍する利那外なる次を我の深みに内面化することに全價存の機みと喜びとを繋ぐものでなければならない。我の深み人落ち込むやうに偶然をして偶々遯逅せしめるのでなければならない。ハイジッガーも「偶然と呼ばれるものは共同環境世界から、決意性へ向つてのみ偶然することが出水る」と云つてるる（Heidexger,SeinundZeit,S300）°+スバースも「把へ得べき如何なる思想をも超えて余は限界狀況に於て驚得を継強し

quote.translation: The one that exists in isolation, at the instant (setsuna, 刹那) when, here or there, it unexpectedly encounters (kaikō, 邂逅) the other, must bind the whole suffering and joy of Existenz to the internalisation of the external thou into the depths of the I. Chance must be made to happen upon us (kaikō, 邂逅) as though it fell into the depths of the I. Heidegger too says that "what is called chance can befall only resoluteness, from the shared environing world" (Heidegger, Sein und Zeit, S. 300), and Jaspers that "beyond any thought that can be grasped, I experience terror in the limit situation, and so experience being one with the chance I have grasped as my own" (Jaspers, Philosophie II, S. 217).

regions.text: 斯くて我がものとして掴んた偶然と一體なることを継験する」と云つて3る（Thspers,PhilosophieILS217）°說卦停に『觀變於險陽而立卦發揮於刚柔而生爻和瓶於道德而理於義窮理盡性以至於命」と云つてゐるのも得然性の賞踐内面化を睨いてゐるにほかならない。

quote.translation: When the Shuogua zhuan says, "They observed the changes in yin and yang and established the trigrams; they brought forth the firm and the yielding and produced the lines; they accorded with the Way and its virtue and set in order what is right; they exhausted principle and fulfilled nature, and so arrived at fate," it too is setting out nothing other than the practical internalisation of contingency.

regions.text: 偶然を成立せしめる二元前相對性は到るところに開主體性を開示するこぎによつて根源社性を橋成する。

quote.translation: The dual relativity that brings chance into being constitutes an originary sociality by disclosing intersubjectivity everywhere.

regions.text: 間主體前社奪性に於ける汝を實存する我の具體的同一性へ同化し内面化するところに、理論に於ける判斷の意味もあつたやうに、實踐に於ける行爲の意味もなするのでなければならない。

quote.translation: Just as the meaning of judgement in theory lay in assimilating the thou of intersubjective sociality to the concrete identity of the I that exists as Existenz, and internalising it there, so the meaning of action in practice lies there too.

regions.text: 道徳が羅に架空なものでなく力として現實に妥管するた

quote.translation: If morality is to be no mere fiction and is to hold good in the actual as a force, it must use the chance it is given as a springboard and stride up towards inwardness.
